hero_description: Innovative platform for verifying tomato crop yield through geolocation technologies and artificial intelligence
project_description: FARM-TECH is an advanced geolocation platform developed with the GeoNode framework, funded by European funds, that revolutionizes tomato crop monitoring.
feature_polygon_drawing: Interactive drawing of polygons on land plots
feature_yield_estimation: Yield estimation in tons per hectare
usage_draw_polygon_desc: Use the interactive drawing tool to delimit the land plot directly on the map. The system automatically recognizes the selected area and prepares it for analysis.
usage_upload_tiff_desc: Already have geospatial data? Directly upload your georeferenced TIFF files and the platform will automatically process the information contained.
usage_ai_algorithm_desc: Our advanced machine learning algorithms analyze satellite data, soil conditions, and historical patterns to generate accurate predictions.
step_area_selection_desc: Draw a polygon on the plot or upload a TIFF file with terrain data
step_area_selection_note: For optimal results, soil data must be collected approximately 70 days before harvest.
step_ai_processing_desc: The algorithm analyzes data using algorithms based on datasets collected from various research lines, freely available from the dedicated page
step_results_desc: Obtain the yield estimate in tons per hectare
funding_description: Cascade Call issued with Rectoral Decree No. 32 of 04/02/2025 of the Mediterranean University of Reggio Calabria, within the framework of the Tech4you – Technologies For Climate Change Adaptation And Quality Of Life Program.
funding_legal: Funded under Public Notice of the Ministry of University and Research No. 3277 of December 30, 2021 for the submission of Intervention Proposals for the creation and strengthening of "innovation ecosystems", construction of "territorial R&D leaders" – Innovation Ecosystems – within the National Recovery and Resilience Plan, Mission 4 Education and Research – Component 2 From Research to Enterprise – Investment 1.5, funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU.
